commit.message:
v57: quiz progress tints, 3D sequence numbers, class-only verdict

- Quiz progress: unsolved quiz-capable boxes get .quizTodo tint
  (select mode only); solved boxes fall back to classic with full
  highlight+numbering while armed (viewer-owns-viewer guard admits
  solved modes). Per-molecule solved sets, cleared on select toggle.
  Chain-first skips solved stashes.
- 3D pick-sequence numbers (mulerSelSeq3D echoes, main-chain only,
  auto-renumbered, cleared on disarm/empty/exact); 3D settings
  toggles no longer resurrect classic numbering while armed.
- Armed H picks fold onto the heavy parent (target hydroxyl /
  aldehyde H stays atomic and selectable from 3D).
- fMulerQuizVerdict is content-only (kind class + glyph + text);
  mulerQuiz-hidden replaces inline display; creation default hidden.
  Kind colors seeded to match rendered output (live hints #333).
- node --check clean (node.exe v26.13.1); skew identical to v56.
  Browser verification pending on the browser machine.

v57: headless 3D regression probe + changelog note

- tools/muler-harness/probe-3d-pick.js: atom/bond/mirror/
  double-tap/quiz-exact/model-unchanged coverage for 3D picking,
  with model-load gate + settle polling for slow applets.
  Browser run pending on a machine with working 3D.

v57: free-mode H↔H rank mirroring via live bond lists

Picking a hydrogen in one viewer now highlights the matching
hydrogen in the other (rank among the parent's H neighbors in
bond-list order, both directions, expanded mode only). The
connectivity table has no H rows (bare 0), so all H neighbor
lookups use bondList/bondList3D instead. Armed fold and
target-H behavior unchanged. Browser verification by owner.

v57: strict 3D paint + condensed/skeletal group completion

3D paint is now strictly 2D-parity (atom picks paint atoms only,
bond picks paint exactly the picked bonds, no auto cross-highlight).
Condensed paint adds fully-selected fragment internals plus H/C-H
completion; 3D atom picks in condensed delegate to the 2D fragment
unit (anchor-only under main-chain carbon rule). Skeletal paint
adds H/C-H plus whole-branch expansion. Quiz compare untouched.
Browser verification by owner.

 ## 2026-11-15 (cont.) — v57 toggle-empty + double-tap fixes (v57 working tree)
 
 * Owner reports: (1) re-click clears only 2D, 3D stays cyan; (2) double-tap empty does nothing.
 * (1) Root cause: toggle-to-empty leaves 3D paint because `Push3D` no-ops on empty (reward-green protection) and nothing else erased it (also affected the reverse direction: 2D unpick leaving 3D cyan). Fix: new `fMulerSelectClear3DIfEmpty()` called at the end of both toggles (2D `fMulerSelectToggle`, 3D `__mulerPickCb`) before quiz refresh — always safe, since reward green is painted after, by refresh.

Fix: flush-on-mousedown — classification extracted into `fMulerSelect3DSilentSettle(px, py)`; a pending timer is settled immediately on the next press (pick flag final by then), otherwise the grace timer settles it. Single silent taps record only; genuine picks break the chain.
